inspiration: Make title and menu art once and export it at two sizes (a 320x240 console-style screen and a 480x272 wide screen). A good plan for our own title art.
A bitmap menu font delivered as a small set of GIF sheets. For us: one pixel-font sheet drawn from scratch, at a fixed cell size.
Launcher icons split into foreground, background and monochrome layers. A good Android practice to follow with our own art.
A side-scrolling beat-em-up lane layout is the engine's home genre (per README). We can use the lane idea with our own characters and stages.
A pack tool that bundles module files into one archive. A useful asset-bundle idea; we would write our own format.
The repo ships no sprites, so the creature, armour and effect look is for us to create. Nothing here is directly visual to copy.

briefs.change: our own wordmark and palette; a different plate shape and glow; no copy of the existing logo
